nrails_snapToRail.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.snapToRail() end
nrails_snapToRail.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: snap to rail
nrails_snapToRail.desc: Puts your vehicle on the nearest railway track (within 40 m), along it the way it faces: a train's wheels between the rails, any other vehicle just over them (Ctrl+Shift+T).

nrails_reloadArea.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.reloadArea(beamngEarth_core) end
nrails_reloadArea.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: reload area
nrails_reloadArea.desc: Asks the world server for the whole area round you again: roads, rails, buildings that did not come (Ctrl+Shift+G).

nrails_toggleWindow.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: show / hide the window
nrails_toggleWindow.desc: The BeamNG.Earth window with Teleport, Snap to rail and Reload area (Ctrl+Shift+U).

nrails_switchLeft.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.setNext('left') end
nrails_switchLeft.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: next turnout to the left
nrails_switchLeft.desc: The next turnout ahead of your train takes its leftmost route (Ctrl+Shift+Left).

nrails_switchStraight.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.setNext('straight') end
nrails_switchStraight.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: next turnout straight
nrails_switchStraight.desc: The next turnout ahead of your train takes its straight route (Ctrl+Shift+Up).

nrails_switchRight.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.setNext('right') end
nrails_switchRight.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: next turnout to the right
nrails_switchRight.desc: The next turnout ahead of your train takes its rightmost route (Ctrl+Shift+Right).

nrails_toggleHelp.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.toggleHelp() end
nrails_toggleHelp.title: BeamNG.EarthNRails: keys help on / off
nrails_toggleHelp.desc: Shows or hides the list of NRails' keys (Ctrl+Shift+I).
